notes.title: Wishlist Our Upcoming Game!
notes.notes:
The story has been completely re-written from start to finish with a brand new script. There's tons of new dialogue choices, to allow for greater immersion into your journey as The Savior. There's a brand new UI, and quality of life changes as well! It's a brand new experience, made as a love letter to those who enjoyed the original, and to those who helped make it happen! Add it to your wishlist today so you can get notified when it releases! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2701070/MajorMinor_20_ReVision/

Also, feel free to join the Discord as well!

notes.title: Winds of Change Now Available!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Saviors!

Our next game, Winds of Change, is 100% complete and out of Early Access.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/594130/Winds_of_Change/

[b]We have a 99% User Review score with almost 120 reviews![/b]

[u][b]And here's what critics have to say about Winds of Change:[/b][/u]

[i]Screenrant:
"The final act is very good, acting like the final mission in Mass Effect 2. There's more to Winds of Change than its cutesy furry exterior provides, with a fascinating overarching story."

Respawning: 
"Klace is able to draw readers in with emotive and well written prose. Every voice fits perfectly. Winds of Change is a quality visual novel; with a rich story and complex characters. You'll find yourself charmed by the world of Alestia, and intrigued by the fate befalling it."

The Gamers Lounge:
"Winds of Change is a wonderful tale. Each character is well developed and feels real, with heart, and consistent motivation behind their actions. You don't have to romance them, but you can become a good friend, and it truly feels that way."

Tribe Games:
"A masterful job has been done with regards to dubbing. I cried like there was no tomorrow. This indie product is a pleasant diamond in the visual novel genre."[/i]

Make sure to check it out today!

Tall Tail Studios

notes.title: Winds of Change Demo Released
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25096360/91feb4c4059eac8eecef43b2f71e5e83dfa7fa7f.png[/img]

[b]Hey Everybody!

A Winds of Change Demo has been patched into Major\Minor.
When you click PLAY, you can choose the Winds of Change Demo!

It's the new game from Tall Tail Studios, coming in 2019.
Please check out the demo and check out the Patreon!

www.patreon.com/winds

Some of the features in Winds of Change are:[/b]

[i]- Full Voice Acting by a professional cast
- Orchestral Score over 2 hours long
- Interaction with the Environment, and World Maps
- Open World Flow (Once you unlock an area, you can always come back)
- The ability to stop at any time and chat with your party members
- Hidden books in the environment to provide lore and insight
- Parallel Chronicles: See what characters around the world are up to
- Party Banter: Stop and observe skits of your party members interacting[/i]

[b]We hope you like it! The demo is several hours long.
It's been about a year of work to make this build happen.[/b]

[i]Klace
Tall Tail Studios
Creative Director[/i]

notes.title: Winds of Change Kickstarter LIVE!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Saviors!

The Kickstarter for our newest game is now live!

Here's a link to check it out, we are honored by any support!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/372114443/winds-of-change-2

As well as a shortened link for sharing on social media:
http://kck.st/2lMkMTU

As well as that, a new patch for Major\Minor was released.
We are calling this the REDUX patch.
It's aimed to increase quality of life while playing Major\Minor.
As well as expedite subsequent playthrough.

Here are the notes for this patch:[/b]

notes.title: Major\Minor - Patch 20 Released
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Community!

Another big patch was released for Major\Minor today.
Here are some of the changes you'll encounter:[/b]

[i]- The new finalized trailer has been uploaded to the Store Page.

- Chapter One has been 100% re-written and revised.

- This is a fully new re-write, superseding the previous revision.

- Chapter Two has been 100% re-written and revised.

- Spelling and grammar errors in Chapter Two have been fixed.

- Chapter Three has been revised further. Full re-write in the works.[/i]

[b]So over the last two weeks -- 30% of the game has been re-written.
This is to fix any tonal inconsistencies and make the game more engaging.
It is now easier and more enjoyable than ever to progress the plot.

Thanks![/b]

notes.title: Chapter 6 + Patch 17 Released
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Community!

Chapter 6 -- "Life\Death" has just released, and is the largest chapter so far.
It comes in at about 20,000 words and has lots of content.
14 Achievements were added into the game for this new chapter.

It has some of the largest events and revelations in the plot so far.
So please be mindful of spoilers when discussing with others.
There is a designated topic on the forums to discuss the new chapter.

But new features have been implemented as well.
Including an overhaul of the previous 5 chapters.

Details are as follows for Patch 17:[/b]

[i]- A distinctive sound effect will play each time a True Ending Flag is attained. This will help people keep track of how many they have if they are paying close attention to the game as they play.

- The alternate portraits of every character have been implemented, and will be highlighted in a CG as they make their entrance into the story and meet the protagonist for the first time.

- Every single choice has been reworded, making it seem more like an active dialogue choice instead of a passive action choice. This will help immersion into the shoes of the protagonist.

- Feedback will appear upon making your choices, and can manifest itself in many possible ways.

- A warning will be given if you are about to make a choice that will change the flow of the story. 

- You will be given brief insight into how the characters feel about the way you are treating them. This -- along with the True Ending Flag audio cue will allow players to steer their playthrough in the direction they want without seeking too much external guidance.[/i]

[b]Thanks so much for all your support!
I worked extremely hard on this latest chapter.
I hope that you are all able to enjoy it.

And the retroactive overhauls ensure that the game is an even greater experience for those who are playing for the first time! So this dual release is a win/win scenario. :)[/b]

[i]Kyle "Klace" Lambert
Tall Tail Studios
Project Lead and Head Writer[/i]
